verified: Only https://pan.baidu.com share URLs are accepted; direct and /share/init?surl= forms normalize to a canonical path.
Cookie input is an explicitly configured local regular file, rejects symlinks and group/other POSIX permissions, has a size bound, and requires BDUSS and STOKEN.
Share root truncation, malformed listings, duplicate paths, and excessive pagination fail closed.
A bounded dry-run discovers a date-named archive and makes no transfer or directory-creation request.
Non-dry-run transfer creates own-drive directories, uses ondup=fail, and verifies remote visibility and exact source size before reporting SAVED.
SQLite transfer intent is durably advanced to UNKNOWN before remote send; a restarted store cannot reclaim it for blind resend and only exact remote size verification can mark it VERIFIED.

BaiduPCS-Go adapter verifies configured UID, has bounded timeout/size/free-space checks, uses argv without a shell or overwrite option, and stages each download under a unique isolated .incoming directory.

A local download-intent manifest records remote path, date, account UID, expected size, and final content fingerprint; after restart a verified staged file is reused, while unknown process outcome or same-size tampering blocks another download.
Authenticated management routes are disabled unless configured and require explicit date and dryRun fields.
not_verified: No real Baidu account, Cookie, share link, transfer, or BaiduPCS-Go download was used.

The BaiduPCS-Go process was replaced by an injected runner in tests; no real download was performed. The API returns DOWNLOADED_UNVALIDATED and requires a later settle-age-gated archive inspection before ingestion.
Baidu web API response stability and authentication behavior require a real account integration run before this capability can be enabled.
side_effects: No network requests were made outside local loopback tests; no real share or drive was modified.
